title: LIMEN — Component Contract
description: OpenAI-compatible forward proxy with capability-matrix routing, key rotation, retry budgets, and intelligent 429 handling (TPM/RPD/RPM/day/month). Asks 'Which key is free?'

component.name: LIMEN
component.description: Router, Key-Pool, 429-Intelligenz, Cooldown-Berechnung, Retry-Budget, Queue, Audit. Jeder API-Call aus dem gesamten Stack geht durch LIMEN.

input.title: LIMEN Input Contract
input.description: OpenAI-compatible ChatCompletion request. Received from goal-chain scripts, KARMA, or any other component making API calls.

caller_component.description: Which component initiated this API call (for audit)

caller_tid.description: goal-chain TID if called from a chain script

output.title: LIMEN Output Contract
output.description: OpenAI-compatible ChatCompletion response with routing metadata.

provider.description: Provider that served the request (e.g., openai, groq, deepinfra, openrouter)

model_used.description: Actual model that responded (may differ from requested if capability-routed)

state.title: LIMEN Persisted State
state.description: SQLite WAL database with key states, audit events, leases, and queue items.

intelligence.title: 429 Intelligence — Rate Limit Detection
intelligence.description: When a 429 is received, LIMEN classifies the rate limit type and computes cooldown.

TPM.name: Tokens Per Minute
TPM.detection: 429 + 'tokens' in message body or x-ratelimit-reset-tokens header
TPM.cooldown: Until next minute boundary (calculate from Retry-After or header)
TPM.strategy: Rotate to next key with TPM budget remaining

RPD.name: Requests Per Day
RPD.strategy: Rotate key, queue if all exhausted

RPM.name: Requests Per Minute
RPM.detection: 429 + 'minute' or generic rate limit without token info

MONTHLY.name: Monthly Quota Exceeded
MONTHLY.cooldown: Until next month or manual reset

CONCURRENT.name: Concurrent Request Limit
CONCURRENT.strategy: Retry with backoff on same key

key_pool.title: Key Pool — Capability Matrix Routing
key_pool.description: Keys are organized by provider, deployment, and capability. Routing selects the best key based on model requirements, rate limit state, and cost.
selection_criteria: Capability match (model family, context window, tool support)
Rate limit state (current TPM/RPD/RPM usage vs. limits)

retry_budget.title: Retry Budget
retry_budget.description: Per-request retry budget with exponential backoff and jitter.

provenance.title: Provenance Policy
provenance.description: LIMEN re-architected concepts from KARMA and Promtguard rather than importing them. This preserves layer isolation.
provenance.policy: Source projects are not named. Concepts are re-implemented for infrastructure context.
provenance.audit_trail: Every API call is recorded in limen_audit_events with caller_component, TID, routing decision, and result.

known_gaps: 207 behauptete Tests — Reproduktion in aktueller Umgebung steht aus
Keine Cross-Component-Integration: LIMEN routet noch keine goal-chain API-Calls
Key-State nicht an goal-chains TID-State gebunden (Rate-Limit → TID-FAIL → Gate)
